description: This file defines outbound message handling for Feishu integration, including functions for sending text, media, and structured cards, with logic for handling local images, comment replies, and rendering modes.

methods.name: normalizePossibleLocalImagePath
methods.description: Normalizes a local image path from text if it is a valid, absolute image file path.

methods.name: shouldUseCard
methods.description: Determines if the message text should be sent as a card based on markdown or table syntax.

methods.name: resolveReplyToMessageId
methods.description: Resolves reply-to message ID from parameters, prioritizing replyToId, then threadId.

methods.name: sendCommentThreadReply
methods.description: Sends a reply to a comment thread in Feishu.

methods.name: sendOutboundText
methods.description: Sends outbound text message, choosing between card or plain message based on render mode and content.
